title: Welcome to Riverside Design
subtitle: Your first look at the team's tasks

scenes.say: [open]This is your team's dashboard. [stats]The cards count every task your team has.
[late]Overdue tasks are the ones to look at first. [list]Below, every task shows who has it and where it stands.
[team]The Team page shows who is doing what. [load]Each bar is a person's tasks against what they can take.
[away]A badge shows who is away, and until when. [next]Check it before you hand out new work.
